catalogue.selector_policy: INSTALLED_LITERAL_DEFAULT; Make/environment overrides are not inferred

families.scope: Signed proof DAGs, conflict-clean consequence, complete supplied reading enumeration and exact raw-source replay preserve independent scopes and premises. The versioned pilot explanation projects the accepted clauses, conditions, conflict exclusions and remaining obligations; it does not authorize a new inference.
open_debts: model_sound requires true facts and preserving rules for the supplied meaning map; the theorem does not acquire that map or authenticate facts.
These installed finite readers are distinct laws; successful routes cannot be silently composed across unsupported grammar.
The existing learned certificate rankers order proposals only; their model score never substitutes for native certificate acceptance.

The pilot explanation renderer is replay-checked and tested, not formally refined. Exact ground application does not establish external case applicability, source truth or action authority; a book-policy-to-ground-rule bridge is not supplied.

explainable-pilot.description: Existing native-checked answer, source spans and proof DAG renderer.
explainable-pilot.scope: Bounded ground reading and replay; renderer correctness is not a general Lean theorem.

core.description: Existing package CLI: cells, readers, learning programs, inquiry and replay.
core.scope: Each selected existing command retains its declared law and scope.

certificate-ranker.scope: Changes proposal order only; every original certificate still requires the existing native checker.

certificate-ranker-v2.scope: Candidate ranking has no acceptance authority; the development split is not a blind Arabic benchmark.

method.role: measurement implementation provenance; not execution authority

limitations: Static literal imports omit implicit package initialization, subprocess/native, data and dynamic execution dependencies.
Direct module-body means an immediate AST child; imports inside conditionals, classes and functions are nested.
ImportFrom adds an inventoried base module and inventoried member modules; attributes are not resolved.
Dynamic-site detection recognizes named importlib loaders and __import__, including import aliases; alias scope/reassignment and arbitrary loaders are not analyzed.
Source columns are zero-based UTF-8 byte offsets; line numbers are one-based.
Self imports remain directed edges; undirected simple projections omit self edges.
Clone spans may overlap; no removable-code total is inferred. Historical versions and independent oracles require separate review.
Entropy and topology establish neither code quality, proof coverage, linguistic coverage nor execution authority.

open_bridge_debts.debt: model_sound requires true facts and preserving rules for the supplied meaning map; the theorem does not acquire that map or authenticate facts.
These installed finite readers are distinct laws; successful routes cannot be silently composed across unsupported grammar.
The existing learned certificate rankers order proposals only; their model score never substitutes for native certificate acceptance.

The pilot explanation renderer is replay-checked and tested, not formally refined. Exact ground application does not establish external case applicability, source truth or action authority; a book-policy-to-ground-rule bridge is not supplied.

limits: The existing compiled catalogue is the sole declaration index; this report does not compile Lean.
Proof and type dependencies may point to definitions outside the advertised theorem population.
Authored routes express a reviewed intended use, not proof of a Python refinement or a dynamic call.
Static imports reuse tools/code_entropy.py and cannot establish execution, source fidelity or semantic coverage.
Binary presence and test references are availability observations; no check is counted as run here.
Open bridge debts remain explicit even when every existing module has a resolved route.
